ops.name: read

ops.text: `Math.ceil` rounds a partial interval up, so a bucket checked 1 ms after a refill already gains a token. It should count whole intervals with `Math.floor` and advance `lastRefill` by exactly those intervals, so the remainder carries over.

args.i: Count whole refill intervals and keep the remainder

onDeny.text: Understood, I left `rateLimit.ts` unchanged. The fix is to replace `Math.ceil` with `Math.floor` and advance `lastRefill` by whole intervals; tell me if you want it applied differently.
